title: Macro Bottom & Micro Leading
abstract: Bottom rebound signal model. 118 triggers, 2006-2025. Top-down Market->Sector->Stock. Best: 11753.66% cumulative, 28.11% annualized vs 10.33%.
strategy: On rebound signal, rank 31 SW industries by momentum into 5 groups, pick Group 5. Rank Group 5 stocks by momentum into 5 groups, pick Group 5. Hold up to n days; switch early on next signal; else hold benchmark. [source: "rank 31 SW L1 industries into 5 groups by rebound momentum score"]
method: Bottom-rebound signal model using only pre-signal data for predictive ability. Pattern: wave-like decline then sharp rebound. Applied to CSI All Share, SW L1 industry indices, broad indices. [source: "the model uses only data prior to the signal date, possessing predictive ability"]
experiment: 5 top-down strategies (2006-2025): Market->Sector, Market->Sector->Stock, Market->Stock, Sector->Stock per industry, Broad->Stock. Benchmark: CSI All Share. [source: "constructs multiple top-down bottom identification and stock selection strategies"]
result: Market->Sector->Stock(20d):11753.66% cumul,28.11% ann vs 10.33%. Sector:1605.55%/15.85%. Market->Stock(60d):8979.24%/26.35%. [source:"cumulative return reached 11753.66%,annualized 28.11%"]
